Hi Jiang,
In case you have not gone through the webiste:
You have to follow the instructions in the userguide, http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/users-guide?hl=en
and follow the Human Exon Array Analysis Bignette at http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis?hl=en
and it works fine.

A question to the developers:
Is it possible to develop a script in R/Perl/Shell so that it will produce the required directory structure and also print out instruction on moving the appropriate files (CEL, CDF etc..) to the appropriate directories? I am afraid to embark on this myself as I live in Linux and Mac world only!

Currently, I do this by hand in a unix linux enviroment but for a regular user this would be helpful.

-Best
